WORKLOG - env_0063 insulin_pump_program_services task 0 (Perpetua Szymborek-Lahti, Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program, Tandem Mobi). Revision 2 (audit round 2 closed C1-C15 and the O-items; see section 13).

1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. The customer asks only for her next infusion-set refill. The PPO tier's past-due hold stands: on the opening ledger, postings on or before 2026-07-15 total 772.35; less 190.00 of payments and 6.85 of correction, the past-due amount is 575.50, against a 75.00 minimum. The way past the hold is a payment plan. The plan's covered balance has to be corrected twice first:
- an overstated non-covered cartridge charge (2a6676cf, 349.35) is reversed down to what its liability notice and CO-151 denial support;
- a non-covered charge the ledger owes on the March 2026 CO-151 line is posted.
The four calculations read the pump ledger, the pump-delivery insulin pharmacy program (orders, vial dispensings and its ledger) and the CGM program (approved CGM plan and its ledger). Factors: 6 + 6 + 6 + 5 = 23, matching the draw.
Decoys:
- the withdrawn earlier pump plan;
- the already-charged 2025 CO-151 denial;
- the September claim still awaiting its remittance;
- the expired A4224 grant;
- product-defect replacements, which are counted, against refills, which are not.

2. SCOPE. Task 0 claims:
- pump_ext_infusion_set_refill_quantity (root), via ship_infusion_set_refill_1f98af27;
- pump_ext_payment_plan_installment (user), via accept_payment_plan_163cafb9;
- pump_ext_unsupported_charge_reversal, via reverse_unsupported_liability_charge_60bc70aa;
- pump_ext_non_covered_item_charge, via post_non_covered_item_charge_86d5d568.
Task 1 claims the cartridge refill, notice, hardship waiver and remittance correction. The two scopes are disjoint and together cover all 8 policies and 8 tools.

3. DRAW. draw_counts.py printed {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 6, 5]}.

- Non-covered charge: 6.
- Plan: 6.
- Set refill: 5.

4. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. The root is pump_ext_infusion_set_refill_quantity.

Edge 1: SET -> PL.
- kind state_gate, gate pump_requests.request_status, form state.
- Sentence: "The infusion-set refill is not shipped until the program's past-due amount, after leaving out any balance an approved payment plan covers, is below the tier's past-due hold minimum."
- Condition, revision 2 (C9): past-due amount after leaving out the balance an approved plan covers (months times installment) is below the minimum.
- Opening: 575.50 and no approved pump plan (a411b480 is withdrawn).
- After the plan: past-due 243.28 less 4 x 43.72 = 174.88 is 68.40, below 75.00.

Edge 2: PL -> RV.
- kind value_input, gate plan_balance.
- Sentence: "The plan's installments are fixed only after the program carries no non-covered item charge larger than the charge its line's liability records and the payer's denial support."
- Opening: 2a6676cf is 342.50 open against 10.28 supported.

Edge 3: PL -> NC.
- kind value_input, gate plan_balance.
- Sentence: "The plan's installments are fixed only after the program's balance carries the non-covered item charge owed for the line the program's newest CO-151 denial bills."
- Opening: denial 0d9457b1 (claim 4bf43b87, shipment 03b7405a) has member waiver 987cdc29, signed against the line's grant d68c72b9, and no charge names 03b7405a.

Edge 4: NC -> RV.
- kind state_gate, gate pump_billing.adjustment_reason.
- Sentence: "A non-covered item charge is posted only after the program carries no non-covered item charge larger than the charge its shipment's liability records and the payer's denial support."

The value_input floor is 2; edges 2 and 3 meet it.
Topological order: RV, NC, PL, SET.
NC before RV is excluded by edge 4. An actual replay in that order gives a reversal of 330.85 (the first-liability courtesy drops to 0) and an installment of 44.06.

Deletion runs (actual replay):

| Write skipped | Effect |
|---|---|
| RV | plan 101.42, balance 585.09 |
| NC | plan 41.32, balance 243.28 |
| PL | past-due stays 243.28, so the refill is held |

Four-point test, applied to each sentence: it is in the blocked rule; it has an ordering connective ("not ... until" / "only after"); it names a record-visible state; and that state is false at the opening and flipped by exactly one write of this difficulty. All edges are state-form.

The approval of the plan is the customer's own act on the call. No status is registered as a completed real-world event. The persona asks only for the sets ("That is the only thing you are asking for."); billing fixes and the plan come up only as passive responses after the representative explains. The tools validate nothing: each body only reads through _Ledger and calls ctx.create / ctx.update.

Revision 4 (KB audit round: renderer findings F1-F7 and the KB auditor's S1-S3). Charter-only changes; no world row, scored value or tool changed.
- F2: the reversal's denied units now follow the base routing. PR-204, or CO-197 where the line's grant was not valid on the ship date (so the denial is not appealed), makes every unit of the line denied. CO-151 keeps units less the covered allowance. Probe on this world's reviewed line: PR-204 gives 316.81; CO-197 with the grant valid gives 342.50 (appealed, nothing supported); CO-197 with an expired grant gives 316.81; CO-16 gives 342.50. The gold line is CO-151, so the result stays 332.22.
- F3: the rule now names the notice the compute reads: the newest notice against the line's grant, if signed on or before the ship date. A later notice covers only later lines of the grant. This sits within the declared cash-price overwrite. Probe: a newer notice dated after the ship date gives liable 0 and a reversal of 342.50; this world has one notice per grant.
- F4: both refill rules state that a tier whose past-due hold days are 0 is never held. The gate conditions say the same.
- F5: the household extension requires an active CGM program. Probe: the CGM program closed gives household 0 and the opening-world plan figure 165.84; this world has an active CGM program, so the extension stays +2.
- F7: every month window carries the same boundary sentence: later than the same day of the month that many months before.
- S2: superseded by revision 6. Each baseline.rule is now the standard method in its own terms (see revision 6).
- S3: the plan reads the most recently received hardship application or approved plan.
On this task's world the probe table's 'no CO-151 denial' row (342.50) now means no CO-151, PR-204 or unappealed CO-197 denial answers the line.

Revision 6 (KB re-audit KB-XF / source root S-XF, XF_recipe.md applied to all eight policies; R2-1). Charter-only changes. No world row, scored value or tool changed; check_compute recomputed every expected value.
- Each policy's rule now has a standard-method paragraph, which is its baseline.rule. It reads only records and default figures and names no factor quantity, zero default or adjustment. Shared quantities are defined there once: the 30-day blocks, the set and cartridge rates, the customer's pump insulin counted in the standard way from J1817, the daily pump insulin over the standard three-month window, the cartridge fill, the covered rate and denied units, the ordered and expected rates, the allowance, the member responsibility, and the value of a denied unit.

- One generic combination sentence per policy carries the result (for example, "Each adjustment set out above changes the charge as it states: replacements first, then the amounts taken off, never below zero, then the percentage reductions, which add together and are taken once from the charge; the charge is then rounded half up to the cent").

This world's reviewed line is CO-151, so the value stays 332.22.
